body.p: In advance of prosecution on the merits, Applicant respectfully requests that the Preliminary Amendment described herein be entered into the record of the above-referenced continuation application.

The present application is a continuation of U.S. Patent Application No. 17/260,678, filed January 15, 2021, and entitled "ANALYTE SENSOR." The Specification has been amended in accordance with 37 CFR §1.78 to claim the benefit of priority and to cross-reference related applications. No new matter has been added.

Claims 1-15 have been cancelled. New claims 16-35 are added. Upon entry of the present Preliminary Amendment, claims 16-35 are pending. No new matter has been introduced since support is found in the original specification.
Applicant respectfully requests prompt and favorable review of this application.

It is believed that no fees are due, or all fees have been paid; however, if the Patent Office believes that additional fees are due, the Patent Office is authorized to charge Deposit Account No. 50-4570.
Attorneys for Applicant Anthony J. Natoli
